title: Deposits Collected under Beverage Container Return Scheme From Beverage Producers and Retailers
what_it_is: Deposits Collected under Beverage Container Return Scheme From Beverage Producers and Retailers

sections.label: Scheme transactions and containers
sections.summary: The Scheme has handled over one million successful transactions and 5.5 million beverage containers returned.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: To date, the Scheme has handled over one million successful transactions, with 5.5 million beverage containers returned.

sections.label: BCRS Ltd scheme finances
sections.summary: BCRS Ltd is a not-for-profit funded by producer fees and recyclables sales, may use unredeemed deposits, and reports annually to NEA.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: On scheme finances, BCRS Ltd is a not-for-profit company funded through the producer fees as well as revenue from the sale of recyclables collected.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Deposits which have been paid for by consumers but are ultimately not redeemed, may be utilised by BCRS Ltd to cover the costs of implementing the scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: BCRS Ltd is required to submit an annual report to the National Environment Agency (NEA), which includes an account of its finances, within three months after the end of each compliance year.

sections.label: Return point network coverage
sections.summary: All 1,070 planned RVMs are deployed and operational, with plans to reach around 2,000 return points in the first year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: On the network coverage of return points, all 1,070 RVMs that were planned for the initial roll-out have been deployed and are operational, allowing over 90% of HDB residents to be within a five-minute walk of an RVM, in addition to machines in the bigger supermarkets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: We have progressively deployed more RVMs since launch and are on track to increase the number of return points to around 2,000 within the first year of implementation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: All hawker centres will either have an RVM on site or a machine located close by.

sections.label: Merchants contacting NEA
sections.summary: Interested merchants are encouraged to contact NEA, and several thousands have already signed up.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I would encourage merchants that are interested to contact NEA.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: This is not relevant to the Parliamentary Question directly, but several thousands have already signed up.
